disposition_reason: Per-product ICP-MS concentrations (Al, Mn, Cu, Se, Rb, Ba) for 22 protein powders, with As, Cd, Hg and Pb below detection in every product.

study.design: cross-sectional market survey of commercial protein powders
study.origin: production country per manufacturer: Czech Republic, Germany, Belgium, Slovakia, UK, EU, USA, Canada (Table 1)
study.market: purchased from online retail sellers, Hungary
study.method: ICP-MS (Agilent 7700X) after HNO3/H2O2 digestion at 180 °C of three 100 mg aliquots, He collision mode for some isotopes; LIBS on pressed pastilles
study.lod_text: Not printed; ND = below the detection limit; LIBS typical LOD stated as ppm level
study.qa: Internal standards (Bi, In, Sc, Y, Li); no CRM or recovery reported
